items.content:
Thirteen codices in a jar, buried in the Egyptian desert around 400 CE,
dug up by a farmer in 1945. Gospels that lost. Nobody preserved them
deliberately — somebody hid them, probably because owning them had become
dangerous, and then died.

The losing side of a canon argument survives because one person panicked
and buried it well.

summary: Lost gospels buried in a jar, dug up by a farmer in 1945
title: On the Nag Hammadi library
